text:
maria: Trying to wire the shared embed helper into the sample-app reranker and hit an assert in batcher.assert_shape. Node demo returns 768-dims, Python demo returns 1024-dims.

devon: Which model aliases and SDK versions? paste the minimal logs.

maria: Node uses node-sdk v0.12 default alias open-embed-v2 -> embeddings length=768. Python uses py-sdk v0.13 open-embed-v3 -> length=1024. rerank expects (batch,1024) -> AssertionError.

sanjay: Two separate DX issues likely: SDK default alias drift and auth-refresh retry semantics. Last week I saw the node SDK retry on token refresh without an idempotency-key which can reorder arrivals in the batch aggregator.

alice: Short-term hack: add normalize_vector(vec, expected_dim) in the shared helper to pad/trim so demos don't break. Longer-term: enforce alias parity in SDKs and add clearer shape checks earlier.

ci-bot: CI: samples/embed-onboard-e2e #128 failed 11 AssertionError in rerank/batcher.py. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/128 (sanitized).

devon: @maria can you paste the sanitized HTTP response body and which auth method was used?

maria: Response body: {"data":[{"embedding":[/* 768 floats */]}]} Headers: Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED-ephemeral>, x-request-id: rq_01abc. trace: rerank/runner.py:117 -> batch_helper.apply_order() -> AssertionError.

sanjay: Confirmed locally: token-refresh retried request omitted idempotency-key header. If the retry finishes before the original, the aggregator which currently indexes by arrival order can end up out-of-order. Combine that with mismatched alias dims and you get the assert.

alice: Action items: 1) add an SDK parity CI that enumerates model aliases across official SDKs and asserts embedding dims match; 2) add a client-side shape validation in the shared helper that raises a friendly error; 3) require idempotency-key header for /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank on retries; 4) update onboarding docs with a quick assert snippet. I'll open GH issues.

alex: I'll take the idempotency-key PR and a small validation patch for the helper. @devon can you own the parity test?

devon: Yep. I'll add a samples CI job that boots node+python SDKs and calls each alias once comparing dims. Also adding a token-refresh integration test to verify idempotency-key preservation.

maria: Pushed a temporary pad_or_trim in samples/onboard to keep demos working and linked failing CI job. Filing repro issue with logs.

alice: Docs note: add `assert len(embedding) == EXPECTED_DIM` to the embed onboarding quickstart and mention alias drift.

sanjay: Filed infra issue for aggregator ordering + idempotency: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/145.

\maria: Thanks all, will update the sample-app PR with repro and screenshots. :thumbsup:
